comment: The changefreq hint written for category URLs in the XML sitemap.
modal: How often category pages are declared to change, as the sitemap `<changefreq>` value: always, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or never. A hint to crawlers, not a guarantee.

comment: The changefreq hint written for product URLs in the XML sitemap.
modal: How often product pages are declared to change in the sitemap (`<changefreq>`): always, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or never.

comment: Whether product images are added to sitemap entries, and which ones.
modal: Controls product image inclusion in the sitemap: **None**, the **Base Only** image, or **All** gallery images.

comment: The changefreq hint written for CMS page URLs in the XML sitemap.
modal: How often CMS pages are declared to change in the sitemap (`<changefreq>`): always, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or never.

comment: The changefreq hint written for the store/home URL in the XML sitemap.
modal: How often the store home URL is declared to change in the sitemap (`<changefreq>`): always, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or never.

comment: Turns scheduled automatic sitemap generation on or off.
modal: When **Yes**, the sitemap is regenerated automatically on a schedule (see the Frequency and Start Time below). When **No**, it is only generated manually.

comment: Email address that receives a notice if scheduled sitemap generation fails.
modal: Where the failure notification is sent when a scheduled sitemap run errors. Applies only when scheduled generation is **Enabled**.

comment: Which store email identity the sitemap error notice is sent from.
modal: The sender identity for the generation-failure email, chosen from the **Store Email Addresses** identities. Applies only when scheduled generation is **Enabled**.

comment: How often the scheduled sitemap regeneration runs.
modal: The cadence of the automatic sitemap run. Applies only when scheduled generation is **Enabled**.

comment: Time of day the scheduled sitemap generation runs.
modal: The hour and minute at which the automatic sitemap run is scheduled. Applies only when scheduled generation is **Enabled**.

comment: Maximum number of URLs written to a single sitemap file before it is split.
modal: Caps how many URLs go into one sitemap file; once exceeded, Magento writes additional files and a sitemap index. Keep within the sitemaps.org limit of 50,000 URLs per file.

comment: Whether the sitemap's location is added to robots.txt.
modal: When **Yes**, a `Sitemap:` line pointing at the generated file is written into robots.txt so crawlers can discover it.
